title: Add makefile target for running the start-of-tournament draft
description:
Add `make tournament-draft` for running a Jumpstart snake-draft at the start of a tournament.

For Season 1 at least, the intended tournament format is Jumpstart with a snake draft. The draft works as follows:

1. Read the tournament entrants from data/tournaments/season-N.json (seeded by Elo)
2. Present each entrant (in snake-draft order: 1,2,...,N,N,...,2,1,1,2,...) with a selection of Jumpstart half-deck packs
3. Each pick is made by the entrant's LLM (using their locked preset/model/personality) via a special draft prompt -- the LLM sees available packs and picks one
4. After all picks, combine each player's two half-decks into their tournament deck
5. Save the draft results and final decklists to the tournament JSON

Snake draft order for 8 players (2 rounds): 1,2,3,4,5,6,7,8,8,7,6,5,4,3,2,1

This is the most complex tournament target. Key design considerations:
- The draft needs a new LLM interaction mode (not a game -- just a prompt/response for each pick)
- Pack generation: how many packs to offer per pick? (probably 3-4 options from data/decks/jumpstart/)
- The LLM needs to see what it already picked in round 1 when making its round 2 pick
- Draft results should be stored in the tournament JSON so they can be displayed on the website
- The draft itself could be an interesting spectator experience (live draft viewer on the website?)

This issue depends on the tournament game runner being implemented first, since the draft produces the decklists used in tournament games.
